## Summary / 摘要

What does this PR do, and why? / 这个 PR 做了什么、为什么?

## Type of change / 变更类型

- [ ] Fix (bug) / 修复
- [ ] Feature / 特性
- [ ] Refactor / 重构
- [ ] Docs / 文档
- [ ] Chore (repo/tooling) / 杂项(仓库/工具)

## Checklist

- [ ] `./gradlew test` passes (full unit suite) — required.
- [ ] No file exceeds 200 lines (project rule) — split if needed.
- [ ] User-facing text covered in both `values/` (EN) and `values-zh/` (ZH).
- [ ] No AI/tooling artifacts committed (`.superpowers/`, `.codegraph/`, etc.).
- [ ] Screenshots/notes for UI changes (if applicable).

## Related issue / 关联 issue

Closes # (if any) / 若有,填编号
